newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU seen valuing late-Dec French wheat at $153.81.
newsitem.headline: EU seen valuing late-Dec French wheat at $153.81.

text.p: A European Union award of 198,900 tonnes of free-market soft wheat at a maximum refund of some 18.00 Ecus per tonne values a tonne of late-December French wheat at $153.81 per tonne, Reuters calculates.
The figure, which should be regarded as an estimate only, is based on benchmark standard-quality French milling wheat at Rouen and may vary significantly for other EU origins and types.
The calculation uses the following assumptions gathered from market sources and Reuters data.
Implied fob price in dollars 153.81 dollars/tonne.
The same formula suggests an unsubsidised French fob price of $178.16 per tonne. --Paris newsroom +331 4221 5146
